blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Streaming vision-language models (VLMs) must continuously integrate information from the past while remaining responsive to current observations and user queries. Existing memory mechanisms typically compress, retrieve, or cache historical observations and reintroduce them into the input context, forcing historical memory and current observations to compete for limited context. We propose MaLoW, a streaming memory framework that instead internalizes historical context into evolving lightweight parameter updates. MaLoW uses a recurrent HyperNetwork to incrementally consolidate incoming video observations into fixed-size LoRA weights, allowing historical information to be carried forward without revisiting the full video stream. In doing so, MaLoW represents history as weights, while keeping the current observation as input. To support training, we further construct MaLoW-Instruct, a large-scale streaming video dataset containing 381K question-answer pairs over 56K videos. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate that MaLoW achieves strong performance on OVO-Bench, StreamingBench, and StreamArena. On the backward split of OVO-Bench, MaLoW outperforms prior memory approaches by 3.9% to 11.8% across different video backbones while incurring only modest latency overhead. Beyond streaming video understanding, MaLoW also generalizes to vision-language-action models, improving the action success rate on Simpler WidowX by 9.3%.
blocks.zh: 流畅的视觉语言模型(VLMs)必须不断融合过去的信息,同时对当前的观察和用户查询保持响应. 现有的内存机制一般会压缩,取回,或缓存历史观察并重新引入输入上下文,迫使历史内存和当前观察竞争有限的上下文. 我们提议 MALOW,一个流传的内存框架, 而不是将历史背景内部化为不断发展的轻量级参数更新。 MaLOW使用一个经常性的HyperNetwork来将接入的视频观测逐渐整合为固定大小的LORA权重,使得历史信息可以不重温整个视频流而被转发. 在这样做的时候,MaLOW代表历史作为权重,同时保留当前观察作为输入. 为了支持培训,我们进一步建造了MaLOW-Instruct,这是一个大型流媒体视频数据集,包含381K个问答对数,超过56K个视频. 我们进行了广泛的实验,以证明MALOW在OVO-Bench,Streaming Bench,和StreamArena上取得了强大的性能. 在OVO-Bench的后向分出时,MaLOW在不同的视频主干线上比先前的内存接近3.9%至11.8%,而只产生适度的潜伏性间接费用. 除了流传的视频理解,MaLOW还概括到视觉语言-动作模型,将Simmer WildieX上的动作成功率提高了9.3%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: By continuously processing an input video stream and responding to user queries, a streaming vision-language model (VLM) must reason over what has already happened, interpret what is happening now, and remain attentive to what may happen next. Such capabilities are central to key tasks ranging from streaming video understanding ( Niu et al., 2025 ) to interactive AI assistants ( Lab, 2026 ) and robotic planning ( Li et al., 2025 ) , where responses and decisions must be made online under latency and memory constraints. Streaming VLMs have thus emerged as an important research frontier. Recent work has shown that offline VLMs can be adapted to describe ongoing activities in streaming videos ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) , while instruction fine-tuning can further enable models to monitor future events ( Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 通过不断处理输入视频流和回答用户的询问,流畅的视觉语言模型(VLM)必须解释已经发生的事情,解释现在发生的事情,并关注接下来可能发生的事情. 此类能力对于关键任务至关重要,从流媒体视频理解(Niu等人,2025年)到互动AI助手(Lab,2026年)和机器人规划(Li等人,2025年),在这些任务中,必须在不定期和内存限制下在网上做出回应和决定. 因此,流转的VLM已成为一个重要的研究前沿。 最近的工作表明,离线的VLM可以被修改,以描述流媒体中正在进行的活动(Shen等人,2026年;Lu等人,2026年),而指令的微调可以进一步使模型能够监测未来事件(Li等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Despite these efforts, a fundamental open problem remains: how should a streaming VLM remember? As in the offline setting, an effective memory mechanism must preserve important visual information within a bounded memory footprint. The streaming setting, however, introduces additional challenges. First , memory must evolve incrementally as new observations arrive, rather than being repeatedly recomputed from the full history. Second , historical information must be incorporated without crowding out the current observation (see Fig. 1 -2). Finally , a practical memory mechanism should introduce minimal inference overhead.
blocks.zh: 尽管作出了这些努力,但仍然存在一个根本的未决问题:一个不断涌现的VLM应该如何记住? 与离线设定一样,有效的内存机制必须在有限度的内存足迹中保存重要的视觉信息. 然而,流动环境带来了更多的挑战。 首先,记忆必须随着新观察的到来而逐步演变,而不是从整个历史中反复重复。 第二,必须纳入历史资料,而不排斥目前的观察(见图1-2)。 最后,实用的记忆机制应当引入最低限度的推断间接费用。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose MaLoW ( M emory a s Lo RA W eights), a framework that internalizes historical context into evolving lightweight parameter updates of a streaming VLM, as illustrated in Fig. 1 -1. MaLoW incrementally consolidates incoming observations into fixed-size LoRA weights, allowing accumulated history to be carried forward without revisiting the full video stream. The base VLM architecture and parameters stay unchanged and only the lightweight LoRA memory evolves over time. More fundamentally, rather than placing memory and current observations in competition within the same context window, as in prior work ( Guan et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , MaLoW represents history as weights while keeping the current observation as input . At each step, the model takes the current observation and user query as input and performs inference using the updated LoRA weights that encode historical information. By separating historical memory from the input context, MaLoW preserves the model’s capacity to attend to current observations while retaining information from the past (Fig. 1 -2), with only modest inference overhead.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出MaLOW(M emory a s Lo RA W 8s),这个框架将历史背景内化为不断演化的轻量级参数更新,如Fig所示. 1-1. MALOW将收到的观测数据逐步合并为固定尺寸的LORA权重,使得累积的历史可以向前推移,而不重温整个视频流. 基础VLM架构和参数保持不变,只有轻量级LORA内存随时间演变. 更根本的是,与其像之前的工作(Guan et al., 2026;Liu et al., 2026;Zhang et al., 2026a)那样,将内存和当前观测放在相同的上下文窗口内进行竞争,马乐W代表历史作为权重,同时保留当前观测作为输入. 在每一步,模型都会将当前观测和用户查询作为输入,并利用编码历史信息的更新LORA权重进行推论. 通过将历史记忆与输入上下文区分开来,MaLOW保留了模型处理当前观测的能力,同时保留了过去的信息(图1-2),只有微小的推论间接.

blocks.en: Specifically, MaLoW employs a recurrent HyperNetwork ( Ha et al., 2017 ) to efficiently generate the LoRA weights that encode historical information. At each time step, the incoming video clip and its textual context are first compressed into a compact representation, which is then used to update a set of recurrent hidden states. To model the temporal dynamics of these hidden states, MaLoW maintains two parallel branches: a state-space model ( Yang et al., 2024 ) for modeling local temporal dependencies, and a gated summation branch for preserving global historical semantics. The resulting states are mapped through a linear projection to the LoRA weights used by the VLM. To facilitate training, we further construct MaLoW -Instruct , a comprehensive streaming video dataset containing 381K question-answer (QA) pairs over 56K videos, by adapting public offline video understanding datasets to the streaming setting.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,MaLOW使用一个经常性的HyperNetwork(Ha等人,2017年)来高效生成编码历史信息的LORA权重. 每一步,即将到来的视频片段及其文字上下文首先压缩成紧凑的表示,然后用来更新一组反复出现的隐藏状态. 为了模拟这些隐藏状态的时间动态,MALOW维持两个平行分支:用于模拟当地时间依赖性的状态-空间模型(Yang等人,2024年),以及用于保护全球历史语义的有门的总结分支. 由此产生的状态通过线性投影到VLM使用的LORA加权. 为了便利培训,我们进一步构建了MaLOW - Instruct,一个包含381K个问答(QA)对56K个视频的全流视频数据集,通过将公共的离线视频理解数据集适应流媒体设置.

blocks.en:
To evaluate our framework, we conduct extensive experiments across benchmarks and settings. MaLoW demonstrates state-of-the-art results on streaming video benchmarks, including OVO-Bench ( Niu et al., 2025 ) , StreamingBench ( Lin et al., 2026 ) and StreamArena ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) .
On the backward split of OVO-Bench, for example, MaLoW outperforms prior memory approaches by 3.9%–11.8% across different video backbones, while incurring modest latency overhead.
Across base VLMs ranging from 0.8B to 11B parameters, MaLoW yields consistent performance gains. Beyond streaming video understanding, we further extend MaLoW to the Vision-Language-Action (VLA) setting, where incorporating historical observations and action trajectories improves the action success rate on Simpler ( Li et al., 2025 ) WidowX by 9.3%.
blocks.zh:
为了评估我们的框架,我们进行了跨越基准和背景的广泛试验。 MaLOW展示了流媒体基准的最新成果,包括OVO-Bench(Niu等人,2025年),Streaming Bench(Lin等人,2026年)和StreamArena(Zhang等人,2026年d月).
例如,在OVO-Bench的后向分割上,MaLOW在不同视频主干线上以3.9~11.8%的优于先前的内存方法,同时产生适度的耐久性间接费用.
在整个基础VLM中,从0.8B到11B参数,MALOW产生一致的性能增益. 除了流传的视频理解之外,我们进一步将MaLOW扩展至远景-语言-行动(VLA)设定,其中纳入历史观察和行动轨迹,将Simmer(Li等人,2025年)寡妇X的行动成功率提高了9.3%。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose MaLoW , a new streaming memory framework that internalizes historical context into evolving LoRA weights, introducing a distinct design in which history is represented as weights while current observations remain as input. • We develop a recurrent HyperNetwork that incrementally updates LoRA memory from streaming video and other context. We also construct MaLoW -Instruct, a large-scale training dataset for streaming video understanding, which we will release publicly . • We demonstrate that MaLoW achieves competitive results across streaming video benchmarks, attains consistent gains over diverse base VLMs, and generalizes to VLA settings.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Vision-Language Models. Vision-language models (VLMs) ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Clark et al., 2026 ; Qwen Team, 2026 ) unify diverse visual understanding and reasoning tasks through a natural-language interface. Among these tasks, long-video understanding ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) is particularly challenging because models must preserve and reason over information spanning extended temporal contexts.
blocks.zh: 远景-语言模式. 视觉语言模型(VLMs)(Liu等人,2023年;Alayrac等人,2022年;Zhang等人,2025年b;Clark等人,2026年;Quen Team,2026年)通过自然语言界面统一多种视觉理解和推理任务. 在这些任务中,长视频理解(周等人,2025年;王等人,2025年)尤其具有挑战性,因为模型必须相对于跨越较长时间范围的信息进行保存和解释。

blocks.en:
Prior works ( Qian et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2024 ) have explored various memory and context-management mechanisms for this offline long video understanding setting.
Our work builds on pretrained VLMs and equips them with an evolving long-term memory that is needed in the streaming video setting and incrementally updated as new observations arrive.
blocks.zh:
之前的作品(Qian等人,2024年;He等人,2024年;Song等人,2024年)为这种离线长视频理解设定探索了各种内存和上下文管理机制.
我们的工作以经过预先训练的甚高频为基础,并为它们配备一种不断变化的长期记忆,这种记忆是流视频设置中需要的,并随着新的观测结果的到来而逐步更新。

blocks.en: Streaming VLMs with Memory. Recent works on streaming VLMs ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) explore several complementary directions, including constructing higher-quality instruction-tuning data, designing architectures tailored to streaming inputs, and incorporating stronger video encoders. More recent studies ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) show that strong VLMs with a small local video window yield surprisingly strong performance on real-time questions on existing streaming video benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 将 VLM 与内存串联 。 近期有关流传VLM的著作(霞等人,2026年;陈等人,2024a年;李等人,2026年;王等人,2026年)探索了几个互补方向,包括构建更高质量的教学调试数据,设计适合流传输入的架构,并纳入更强大的视频编码器. 较近期的研究表明(Lu等人,2026年;Shen等人,2026年),具有小型本地视频窗口的强力VLM在目前流媒体视频基准的实时问题上获得了惊人的强效表现.

blocks.en:
Another line of work focuses on the memory mechanisms. Some methods compress historical visual observations into textual summaries or memories ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Guan et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) , while others reduce the accumulated visual tokens through clustering or token merging ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Additional approaches organize historical information into hierarchical memory structures ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) , or maintain a fixed-size memory buffer that selectively preserves useful historical observations ( Qian et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) .
Despite their differences, these methods generally address the growing streaming context by compressing historical information into a bounded token budget. In contrast, we represent long-term memory directly in model weights.
blocks.zh:
另一行工作侧重于记忆机制. 一些方法将历史视觉观测压缩成文字摘要或记忆(刘等人,2026年;关等人,2026年;姚等人,2026年),而其他方法则通过集群或符号合并减少累积的视觉符号(张等人,2024年). 其他方法将历史信息整理成分级记忆结构( Zen等人,2026年;张等人,2026年a;谢等人,2026年;梁等人,2026年),或保持固定大小的记忆缓冲,有选择地保存有用的历史观测结果(Q等人,2025年;姚等人,2025年).
尽管存在差异,这些方法一般通过将历史信息压缩成限定符号的预算来解决日益增长的流派背景. 相比之下,我们在模型权重中直接代表长期记忆.

blocks.en: Concurrent work ( Chen et al., 2026 ) similarly moves long-term memory outside the attention context. However, it stores historical information in a separate test-time-training (TTT) branch with online-updated fast weights. In contrast, our method directly internalizes history into the VLM itself by dynamically generating low-rank parameter adaptations, without introducing a separate memory branch.
blocks.zh: 同时期工作(Chen et al., 2026)同样将长期记忆移到关注背景之外. 然而,它将历史信息存储在一个单独的测试时间-训练(TTT)分支中,具有在线更新的快速权重. 相比之下,我们的方法直接将历史内部化为VLM本身,通过动态生成低排名参数的适应,而不引入单独的内存分支.

blocks.en:
Low-Rank Adaptation and Context Internalization. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) ( Hu et al., 2022 ) has been widely adopted as a parameter-efficient approach for adapting pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) and multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) to downstream tasks or new domains ( Dettmers et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2025 ) .
Recently, several works have explored using LoRA as a representation for encoding data-specific patterns ( Shrestha et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2026 ) or contextual information ( Charakorn et al., 2026 ; Charakorn et al., 2025 ) . These approaches demonstrate that model parameters can be a good representation for storing information beyond conventional token-based context. However, they typically require additional optimization when adapting to a new pattern, making it difficult to apply them directly to evolving inputs. δ \delta -mem ( Lei et al., 2026 ) explores dynamically representing textual information through LoRA updates without test-time training. Nevertheless, it still relies on access to the historical context during inference.
blocks.zh:
低Rank适应与内在化. 低等级适应(LORA)(Hu等人,2022年)被广泛采用为参数效率方法,将预先训练的视觉语言模型(VLMs)和多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)适应下游任务或新领域(Dettmers等人,2023年;Chen等人,2024年b;Liu等人,2025年).
最近,有几部作品探索使用LORA作为编码数据特定模式的代表(Shrestha等人,2025年;Yin等人,2026年)或背景资料(Charakorn等人,2026年;Charakorn等人,2025年)。 这些方法表明,模型参数能够很好地反映常规符号上下文之外的信息储存情况。 然而,在适应新模式时,它们通常需要额外的优化,因此难以直接应用于不断变化的投入。 δ\delta-mem(Lei等人,2026年)通过LORA更新,在没有测试时间训练的情况下探索动态代表文本信息. 然而,在推论期间,它仍然依赖于对历史背景的了解。

blocks.en: Different from these prior approaches, our work specifically handles the streaming setting, and introduces a context internalization mechanism that progressively incorporates incoming visual context into low-rank model representations.
blocks.zh: 与这些先前的方法不同,我们的工作专门处理流化环境,并引入一种背景内化机制,逐步将所进入的视觉环境纳入低级模型表述.

blocks.en: To train MaLoW to enable adapted VLMs to retrospect over past observations, preserve relevant information for understanding the present, and support future responses or actions, we construct a comprehensive training dataset for streaming video understanding, named as MaLoW -Instruct .
blocks.zh: 为了培训MaLOW,使经过改造的VLM能够回顾过去的观测,保存相关信息以了解当前情况,并支持未来的应对或行动,我们构建了一个综合培训数据集,用于流传视频理解,命名为MaLOW - Instruct.

blocks.en:
Data Sources and Dataset Construction. Our data construction pipeline consists of three main components: (1) a question generator , (2) an answer generator , and (3) an verifier (Fig. 3 -1).
We build on existing video temporal grounding and procedural action datasets that provide event/action timestamps and corresponding descriptions. For each annotated event, the question generator takes the video together with the event description and generates candidate questions about either the target event itself or its surrounding context, an expected answer , along with the question timestamps t t . We consider diverse question formats, including open-ended, multiple-choice, and yes/no questions. To prevent data leakage, we filter out the samples used in OVO-Bench ( Niu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
数据源与数据集构建. 我们的数据构建管道由三个主要部分组成:(1) 问题生成器,(2) 答案生成器,(3) 验证器(图3-1)。
我们以现有的视频时间定位和程序行动数据集为基础,提供事件/行动时间戳和相应的描述。 对于每个附加说明的事件,问题生成器会将视频与事件描述合并,并生成关于目标事件本身或其周围背景的候选问题,一个预期的答案,以及问题时间戳 t t. 我们考虑不同的问题形式,包括开放式、多选择和是/否问题。 为防止数据泄漏,我们过滤了OVO-Bench(Niu等人,2025年)中使用的样本。

blocks.en:
Given a generated question, the answer generator then processes the video up to timestamp t t and produces a model answer . Finally, the verifier takes the generated question, expected answer , model answer , and the video context surrounding the target event to assess both the validity of the question and the correctness of the answer. An unreasonable question or an inconsistent answer typically results in disagreement between the expected answer, generated answer, and supporting video context. We therefore retain only QA pairs that pass the verification stage to form the final training dataset.
We use Qwen3.5-122B-A10B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as both the question and answer generator, and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B as the verifier. Please see more details in the Appendix B.1 and B.2 .
blocks.zh:
鉴于一个产生的问题,答案生成器然后将视频处理到时间戳 t t 并生成模型答案。 最后,核查者将生成的问题,预期答案,模型答案,以及围绕目标事件的视频背景,以评估问题的有效性和答案的正确性. 一个不合理的问题或不一致的答案通常导致预期答案、生成的答案和支持视频背景之间的分歧。 因此,我们只保留通过核查阶段的质量保证对数据,以形成最后的培训数据集。
我们使用Quen3.5-122B-A10B (Quen Team, 2026)作为问答生成器,而Quen3.5-397B-A17B作为验证器. 详见附录B.1和B.2。

blocks.en:
Dataset Statistics. MaLoW -Instruct contains 381K instruction samples on 56K videos. We summarize the distributions and statistics of the videos and questions in Fig. 3 -2. Approximately 36% of the QA pairs have query timestamps that occur after the corresponding event has ended, providing explicit supervision for learning the MaLoW module to retain and retrieve historical information. Moreover, for many real-time questions, part of the relevant event falls outside the current observation window, further encouraging the model to leverage historical context through MaLoW . The question types are approximately evenly distributed among multiple-choice, open-ended, and yes/no questions. The videos are collected from 14 datasets, among which CosMo-Cap ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , YouCook2 ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) , Charades-STA ( Gao et al., 2017 ) , and ActivityNet-Captions ( Krishna et al., 2017 ) together account for 62.5% of all videos.
More dataset statistics are presented in the Appendix B.3 .

we evaluate MaLoW on the Real-Time split of StreamingBench ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , as well as the Real-Time and Backward splits of OVO-Bench ( Niu et al., 2025 ) .
The Backward splits of OVO-Bench mostly focus on retrospect to the past and comprise three tasks: Episodic Memory (EPM), Action Sequence Identification (ASI), and Hallucination Detection (HLD). Among them, EPM is particularly well suited for assessing the effectiveness of the memory mechanism introduced by MaLoW .

blocks.en: Experiment Protocol. We build MaLoW on top of a diverse set of VLMs, including models pre-trained for offline video understanding (Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) ) and models designed for streaming video (VideoChat3-4B ( Li et al., 2026 ) and MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B ( Wang et al., 2026 ) ). Across all base VLMs, MaLoW operates in a streaming setting with a local context window: at each time step t t , only the most recent video clip C t C_{t} is provided as the current observation, while all preceding clips C 0 : t − 1 C_{0:t-1} are consolidated into the evolving model weights.
blocks.zh: 实验协议。 我们在一套多样化的VLM之上搭建了MALOW,包括用于离线视频理解的预训模型(Qwen3-VL-4B(Bai等人,2025年)和Quen3.5-9B(Quen Team,2026年))以及用于流媒体视频的模型(VideoChat3-4B(Li等人,2026年)和MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B(Wang等人,2026年)). 在所有基础VLM中,MaLOW运行在带有本地上下文窗口的流媒体环境中:在每一步 t 时,仅提供最新的视频剪辑 C t C_{t}作为当前观测,而之前所有的剪辑 C 0: t − 1 C_{0: t-1} 则被整合到不断发展的模型加权中.

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. We apply rank-8 LoRA to the MLP in each attention layer and v_proj layers in each self-attention layer. For Qwen3.5-9B, we additionally apply LoRA to the in_proj_qkv_proj layers in its linear-attention blocks. For MOSS-VL, we additional apply v_proj layers in each cross-attention layer.
We use a four-layer self-attention network as the aggregator, with a hidden dimension of 512 and eight attention heads. For each layer of the base model, we learn an independent query and maintain a corresponding hidden state. We instantiate the SSM using a four-layer DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2024 ) with a hidden dimension of 512. To generate the LoRA parameters, we learn separate linear projection layers for each target module and LoRA rank component.
We train MaLoW on the training data introduced in Sec. 3.4 for 2,800 steps with a total batch size of 64. We use the Adam optimizer with a peak learning rate of 8 × 10 − 5 8\times 10^{-5} and a cosine learning-rate schedule.
The videos are sampled at 1 fps during training and inference of MaLoW . Each C t C_{t} is a 2-second video clip.
Additional implementation details are provided in the Appendix C.1 .

blocks.en: Baselines. We categorize the baselines into four groups according to the model types and how they manage historical visual context during streaming inference. 1. Offline VLMs. This category includes LLaVA-Video-7B ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , LongVU-7B ( Shen et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , and Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . We compare to these models for their strong video understanding capabilities, acquired through large-scale video-text pretraining. We evaluate their pretrained checkpoints by treating streaming videos as offline inputs. 2. Streaming VLMs with Long-term (Full) Context. This category includes VideoLLM-Online ( Chen et al., 2024a ) , Streamo ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , VideoChat3 ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and MOSS-VL-Realtime ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . These methods preserve historical observations directly in the inference context as memory for streaming video understanding, and for short videos often retaining the entire video history. As the stream grows, this leads to an ever expanding context window and substantial memory and computational overhead. We note that VideoChat3 uses a local context window on OVO-Bench, while retaining the full historical context on StreamingBench. 3. Streaming VLMs with a Local Context Window. This category includes Mage-VL ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , SimpleStream ( Shen et al., 2026 ) , and AURA ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . We compare to these models for their strong real-time performance, achieved by retaining only the most recent observations within a fixed local window of approximately 4–30 seconds. Historical observations that fall outside the local window are evicted ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . 4. Streaming VLMs with a Local Context Window and Memory Mechanism. This category includes Flash-VStream ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , Dispider ( Qian et al., 2025 ) , TimeChat-Online ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , StreamForest ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) , JoyAI-VL ( Yao et al., 2026 ) , HERMES ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , ThinkStream ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , VST ( Guan et al., 2026 ) , OASIS ( Liang et al., 2026 ) and StreamTTT ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Similar to our design, these methods retain most recent observations in a local context window while compressing historical information into a more compact memory representation, such as textual summaries or condensed visual features. Among them, the concurrent work StreamTTT is most relevant. StreamTTT stores historical information in an online-updated test-time-training (TTT) branch while retaining the most recent visual tokens as the current observation.

blocks.en: MaLoW achieves state-of-the-art results. As shown in Table 1 , MaLoW establishes strong performance across streaming video benchmarks. MaLoW (MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B) and MaLoW (Qwen3-VL-4B) achieve new state-of-the-art scores of 74.5% and 84.8% on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench, respectively, while MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) attains the highest EPM score of 63.6% among all compared methods.
blocks.zh: MaLOW实现最新成果. 如表1所示,MALOW在流媒体视频基准方面建立了良好的业绩。 MALOW(MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B)和MALOW(Qune3-VL-4B)在OVO-Bench和Streaming Bench上分别达到74.5%和84.8%的新先进分数,而MaLOW(Qune3.5-9B)在所有比较方法中达到63.6%的最高EMM分数.

blocks.en:
We highlight key comparisons at matched model scales. At the 4B scale , the MaLoW (Qwen3-VL-4B) surpasses the concurrent work StreamTTT-4B ( Chen et al., 2026 ) by 3.9% and 3.5% on the backward split of the OVO-bench and StreamingBench, respectively. At the 7-9B scale , the MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) outperforms the previous memory-based method OASIS-8B ( Liang et al., 2026 ) and local window-based method AURA-8B ( Lu et al., 2026 ) by 9.2% and 6.0% on the backward split of the OVO-bench, respectively. At the 11B scale , MaLoW (MOSS-VL-Real-11B) improves over its base MOSS-VL-Real-11B by 2.2% and 1.4% on the Real-Time split and EPM task of OVO-Bench, respectively.
We recognize that on the OVO-Bench real-time split, MaLoW (Qwen3-VL-4B) and MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) underperform StreamTTT-4B and AURA-8B, respectively. We hypothesize that these baselines may have benefited from fine-tuning their base VLMs, whereas MaLoW keeps the base VLMs intact.
blocks.zh:
我们强调在相应的模型尺度上的关键比较。 在4B级中,MaLOW(Qune3-VL-4B)在OVO-bench和Streaming Bench的后向拆分上分别比StreamTT-4B(Chen等人,2026年)高3.9%和3.5%。 在7-9B尺度上,MaLOW(Quen3.5-9B)在OVO-bench的后向拆分上分别比上一个基于内存的方法OASIS-8B(Liang等人,2026年)和本地基于窗口的方法AURA-8B(Lu等人,2026年)高出9.2%和6.0%. 在11B规模上,MALOW(MOSS-VL-Real-11B)在OVO-Bench的实时拆分和EMM任务上分别比其基础MOSS-VL-Real-11B提高了2.2%和1.4%.
我们认识到,在OVO-Bench实时拆分中,MaLOW(Qune3-VL-4B)和MaLOW(Qune3.5-9B)分别表现不佳,StreatTT-4B和AURA-8B. 我们假设这些基线可能得益于调整其基准的VLM,而MALOW则保持基准的VLM完好无损.

blocks.en: Collectively, these results show that MaLoW is particularly effective on memory-critical tasks while retaining competitive performance on real-time perception. Importantly, the gains are consistent across model scales from 4B to 11B and across base VLMs pre-trained for both offline video understanding (Qwen series) and streaming video understanding (VideoChat3 and MOSS-VL-Realtime).
blocks.zh: 这些结果集体表明,MaLOW在记忆关键任务上特别有效,同时保留实时感知上的竞争性表现. 重要的是,从4B到11B的模型尺度和基础VLM在离线视频理解(Quen系列)和流线视频理解(VideoChat3和MOSS-VL-Realtime)两方面的预训都一致。

blocks.en: MaLoW offers a lightweight memory patch. Across different base VLMs, MaLoW introduces only 1.4%-4.0% additional parameters. The pretrained backbone architecture and parameters remain unchanged, while historical information is encoded entirely through the evolving LoRA weights. Preserving the backbone helps retain its pretrained capabilities and minimizes interference with real-time perception. Moreover, widespread LoRA support in modern inference frameworks facilitates efficient deployment.
blocks.zh: MaLOW提供轻量级记忆补丁. 在不同的基数VLM中,MALOW只引入1.4%-4.0%的额外参数. 预先训练的骨干架构和参数保持不变,而历史信息则完全通过不断发展的LORA权重编码. 保留骨干有助于保留其预先训练的能力,并尽量减少对实时感知的干扰. 此外,现代推论框架中的LORA广泛支持有助于高效部署。

blocks.en:
MaLoW incurs minor inference overhead. We profile the streaming inference latency of MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) and four baselines on 100 deterministically sampled questions from OVO-Bench. At each query timestamp t t , we measure the time required to process the current observation, prefill the KV cache, and decode the first token. For MaLoW , we additionally include the cost of generating and applying the LoRA weights. Further experimental details are provided in Appendix C .
As shown in Fig. 4 , MaLoW achieves a favorable trade-off between inference latency and performance on memory-critical tasks. The additional latency introduced by our memory mechanism is only around 23 ms, accounting for less than 15% of the total inference time (Table 15 in the Appendix). Moreover, LoRA generation can be parallelized with backbone inference, providing further opportunities to reduce the runtime overhead.
blocks.zh:
MALOW承担了小的推断费用。 我们描述了MaLOW(Quen3.5-9B)的流派推论纬度,以及从OVO-Bench抽取的100个决定性问题的4个基线。 在每次查询时间戳 t t 时,我们测量处理当前观察,预填 KV 缓存,解码第一个符号所需的时间. 对MaLOW来说,我们还包括产生和应用LORA权重的费用。 进一步的试验细节见附录C。
如图4所示,MaLOW在对记忆关键任务进行推论延迟和表现之间实现了有利的权衡. 我们的记忆机制引入的额外延缓时间只有23ms左右,占总推断时间的不到15%(附录表15). 此外,LORA生成可以与骨干推论平行,为减少运行时间间接费用提供进一步的机会.

blocks.en:
MaLoW excels at long-horizon memory tasks. We further stress-test our memory mechanism on the Historical Retrospection (HR) split of StreamArena ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) ; implementation details are provided in Appendix C . HR specifically targets long-horizon memory: the query is issued substantially later than the appearance of the relevant visual evidence, with a median query-evidence gap of 12.1 minutes. We compare MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) with strong streaming video models, including MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , VideoChat3-4B ( Li et al., 2026 ) , AURA-8B ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , and VST-7B ( Guan et al., 2026 ) . These models either maintain a long context window (MOSS-VL-Realtime), or compress historical observations into text-based memory (VideoChat3, AURA, and VST).
As reported in Table 4 , MaLoW achieves an average score of 22.8, outperforming VST and MOSS-VL-Realtime by 2.2% and 4.5%, respectively. These results highlight the effectiveness of representing history in evolving model weights for retaining information over long temporal horizons.
blocks.zh:
MaLOW在长距离记忆任务上表现优异. 我们进一步在StreamArena(张等人,2026d)的历史回顾(HR)分裂上测试我们的记忆机制;执行详情见附录C。 HR特别针对长视距内存:查询发布时间大大晚于相关视觉证据的出现,中位查询-证据间隙为12.1分钟. 我们比较了MaLOW(Quen3.5-9B)与强流视频模型,包括MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B(Wang等人,2026年),VideoChat3-4B. (Li等人,2026年),AURA-8B(Lu等人,2026年),以及VST-7B(Guan等人,2026年). 这些模型要么维持一个长上下文窗口(MOSS-VL-Realtime),要么将历史观测压缩成基于文本的内存(VideoChat3,AURA,和VST).
如表4所示,MALOW的平均得分是22.8,优于VST和MOSS-VL-Realtime,分别为2.2%和4.5%。 这些成果突出表明,在不断变化的模型权重中代表历史对于长期保存信息是有效的。

blocks.en:
MaLoW generalizes across model scales and families. We further evaluate MaLoW across a broader range of model scales (0.8B–4B) and model families (Qwen3.5 and Gemma4); implementation details are provided in Appendix C . Following the official benchmark protocols, we evaluate all three splits of OVO-Bench (Backward, Real-Time, and Forward) and all four splits of StreamingBench (Real-Time, Omni, Proactive, and SQA). For each backbone, we compare MaLoW against two baselines: (1) the corresponding base model operating with full context and (2) the same model restricted to a local context window.
Table 4 shows that MaLoW consistently improves overall performance across model scales and families . In particular, MaLoW outperforms the full-context baseline on real-time perception splits ( green cells ), demonstrating that MaLoW effectively alleviates the negative effect of history on real-time perception. Meanwhile, MaLoW substantially improves over the local-window baseline on memory-intensive splits ( blue cells ), highlighting the effectiveness of the internalized memory.
blocks.zh:
MALOW概括了模型尺度和家庭. 我们从更广泛的模型规模(0.8B-4B)和模型家庭(Quen3.5和Gemma4)进一步评估MaLoW;附录C提供了实施细节。 遵循官方的基准协议,我们评价OVO-Bench的所有三个拆分(Backward, Real-Time, and Forward)和Streaming Bench的所有四个拆分(Real-Time, Omni, Provication, and SQA). 对于每个主干线,我们比较MaLOW与两个基线:(1) 运行于完整上下文的相应基模型和(2) 仅限于本地上下文窗口的同一模型.
表4显示,劳动与福利部不断提高示范规模和家庭的总体业绩。 特别是,MaLOW在实时感知分裂(绿色细胞)上超越了全文本基线,表明MaLOW有效缓解了历史对实时感知的负面影响. 同时,MaLOW大大改善了内存密集分裂(蓝色细胞)的本地窗口基线,突出了内化内存的有效性.

Extension to Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models. We further extend MaLoW to robotic planning, where it is used to internalize historical visual observations and action trajectory for action prediction. Following VLM4VLA ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , we adapt Qwen3.5-2B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) by attaching a lightweight MLP action decoder and fine-tuning the VLM backbone, resulting in our baseline model, Q3.5-2B-MLP . The model is trained on the Bridge and RT-1 subsets of the OXE dataset ( O’Neill et al., 2024 ) to predict future actions based solely on the current visual observation.
We then train MaLoW on top of Q3.5-2B-MLP using the Bridge subset of OXE. During this stage, the VLM backbone is frozen and receives only the current observation, while MaLoW and the MLP action decoder are optimized to internalize historical observations and action trajectories and produce more accurate action trajectories. We refer to the resulting model as MaLoW (Q3.5-2B-MLP) .
We evaluate both models on the Simpler-Bridge with WidowX robot, with results reported in Table 4 . MaLoW improves the average success rate from 59.4% to 68.8%, corresponding to a major gain of 9.4% . These results demonstrate that MaLoW can effectively internalize historical information and leverage it to refine action trajectories without explicitly providing them to the base model. Appendix C.2 provides more implementation details.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we presented MaLoW , a new memory framework for streaming VLMs. Rather than repeatedly injecting compressed or retrieved history into the input context, MaLoW represents history as LoRA weights while keeping the current observation as input . This separation provides a natural way to carry long-term information forward without revisiting the full video stream or continually expanding the context window. It also yields a lightweight memory patch : the base VLM architecture and parameters remain unchanged, while only the compact LoRA weights evolve over time.
To realize this design, we developed a recurrent HyperNetwork that incrementally updates LoRA weights, together with MaLoW -Instruct , a large-scale streaming video dataset containing 381K QA pairs over 56K videos. MaLoW achieves strong results across streaming video understanding benchmarks, with substantial gains on memory-critical tasks and only modest inference overhead. We further show that the same memory mechanism transfers to VLA models, where incorporating historical context improves action success. We hope that MaLoW offers a useful perspective on long-term memory for streaming VLMs: beyond asking what information should be stored or retrieved, we can also reconsider where memory should reside , in this case, directly within evolving model weights.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们提出了MaLOW,一个流传VLM的新记忆框架. MaLOW不是在输入语境中反复注入压缩或检索历史,而是将历史代表为LORA权重,同时将当前观察作为输入. 这种分离提供了一种自然的方式,在不重温完整视频流或持续扩展上下文窗口的情况下,将长期信息传送到前方. 它还产生一个轻量级的内存补丁:基础VLM架构和参数保持不变,而只有紧凑的LORA权重随时间演变.
为了实现这个设计,我们开发了一个经常性的HyperNetwork,它与MaLOW -Instruct一起逐渐更新了LORA的权重,这是一个大型的流线视频数据集,包含381KQA对超过56K的视频. MaLOW在跨流视频理解基准方面取得强效成果,在记忆关键任务上取得了实质性成果,并且只有适度的推论间接费用. 我们进一步表明,同样的内存机制向VLA模型转移,纳入历史背景可以提高行动的成功。 我们希望MaLOW为流传的VLM提供长期记忆的有益视角:除了询问应该存储或检索哪些信息外,我们还可以重新考虑记忆应位于何处,在此情况下,直接存在于不断发展的模型权重之内.

blocks.en: MaLoW carries information from earlier video clips through history-dependent parameter updates. This appendix provides a mathematical interpretation of the feasibility of encoding the effect of historical context into low-rank updates of the MLP projections within a Transformer block. Specifically, we trace how a query reads historical information in section A.1 , how this read induces a transformation of the features entering the MLP in section A.2 , and how such a transformation can be realized or approximated by LoRA-style weight updates in section A.3 . The analysis does not claim that MaLoW explicitly reconstructs the analytical history matrix M H M_{H} or is equivalent to full-context attention. Rather, it establishes that historical information can, under the assumptions described below, be represented in parameter space through low-rank updates. MaLoW can be viewed as one of the learned instantiations of this principle, with our empirical results demonstrating that its recurrent state and generated adapters effectively preserve history-dependent information in practice. The exact identities below first assume fixed historical keys and values and an unnormalized dot-product read, while Section A.4 and Section A.5 extend the interpretation to the online setting, normalized attention, and the normalization operations in the backbone.

blocks.en: In conclusion, this analysis establishes the theoretical feasibility of compressing the effect of historical context into low-rank parameter updates of the MLP modules within a Transformer block. In particular, it shows that, under the assumptions described above, a history-dependent feature transformation induced by historical context can be realized or approximated through LoRA-style updates to the MLP projections. Importantly, this analysis does not claim that MaLoW exactly reconstructs the analytical history matrix M H M_{H} , nor that its learned recurrent state and generated adapters are equivalent to full-context attention. Rather, the derivation provides a mathematical interpretation demonstrating that such a parameter-space representation of historical information is feasible. Our empirical results further show that MaLoW provides an effective learned instantiation of this approximation in practice.
blocks.zh: 总之,本分析确立了将历史背景的影响压缩成一个变形器块内MLP模块的低级参数更新的理论可行性. 特别是,它表明,根据上述假设,通过LORA式更新MLP预测,可以实现或大致实现由历史背景引发的历史依赖特征转变. 重要的是,这一分析并没有声称MaLOW完全重建了分析历史矩阵MH MQQH},也没有声称其所学的反复出现状态和生成的适配器相当于全文本的关注. 相反,这一推论提供了一种数学解释,表明历史信息的这种参数空间表述是可行的。 我们的经验结果进一步表明,MaLOW在实际中为这种近似提供了有效的学识即兴.

blocks.en: We begin the dataset construction by collecting videos from multiple existing sources, including TimeLens-100K ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , the academic subset of LLaVA-Video-178K ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , ET-Instruct ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , and several additional video datasets, including YouCook2 ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) , CrossTask ( Zhukov et al., 2019 ) , and THUMOS14 ( Idrees et al., 2017 ) . We primarily build upon these large-scale collections rather than gathering every underlying dataset independently, as they already consolidate videos from diverse academic sources and have undergone prior curation and preprocessing, providing a more scalable and reliable starting point for dataset construction. To prevent evaluation contamination, we further filter out videos that overlap with those used in OVO-Bench ( Niu et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, StreamingBench and StreamArena do not overlap with any of our video sources and therefore require no additional filtering. After aggregating all sources and removing duplicate and overlapping videos, the resulting dataset contains 55,867 unique videos drawn from 14 underlying video datasets. A detailed breakdown of the video distribution is provided in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 我们从多个现有来源收集视频开始数据集构建,包括TimeLens-100K(张等,2026c),LLaVA-Video-178K(张等,2025b)的学术子集,ET-Instruct(刘等,2024),以及多个额外的视频数据集,包括YouCook2(周等,2018),CrossTask(朱可夫等,2019),THUMOS14(Idrees等,2017). 我们主要依靠这些大规模收集资料,而不是独立收集所有基本数据集,因为这些资料已经综合了来自不同学术来源的视频,并经过了事先的整理和预处理,为数据集的构建提供了更加可扩展和可靠的起点。 为了防止评估污染,我们进一步过滤与OVO-Bench(Niu等人,2025年)中使用的视频重叠的视频。 相比之下,Streaming Bench和StreamArena与我们的任何视频来源并不重叠,因此不需要额外的过滤. 在汇总所有来源并删除重复和重叠的视频后,所产生的数据集包含从14个基本视频数据集抽取的55 867个独有视频. 录像带的分发详情见表5。

blocks.en: B.2 Data Pipeline and Annotation Construction
blocks.zh: B.2 数据管道和注释建筑

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 3 -1, our data construction pipeline consists of three components: a Question Generator , an Answer Generator , and a Verifier . To construct the streaming video training dataset, we begin with an event description associated with a specific temporal interval. These descriptions are obtained either from the original annotations of the 14 datasets described in Section B.1 , or from the question–answer pairs provided by TimeLens and ET-Instruct.
blocks.zh: 如图3-1所示,我们的数据构建管道包括三个部分:问题生成器、答题生成器和验证器。 为了构建流式视频培训数据集,我们首先要描述与特定时间间隔相关的事件。 这些说明或来自B.1节所述14个数据集的原始说明,或来自TimeLens和ET-Instruct提供的问答对。

blocks.en:
Question Generation. We first prompt the Question Generator to generate a new question for a target event, conditioned on the full video, the event description, and its corresponding temporal interval. By observing the full video, the Question Generator can leverage both the target event and its surrounding visual context to construct a question that is grounded in the video content. The prompt explicitly controls the question type, which is sampled from four categories: open-ended, multiple-choice, Yes/No, and counting questions. Along with each generated question, the Question Generator also produces an expected answer , which is subsequently used during the verification stage.
To cover different temporal reasoning scenarios, we further assign each question a randomly sampled question-timestamp type from three categories: past , real-time , and future . Given a target event spanning the interval [ t start , t end ] [t_{\mathrm{start}},t_{\mathrm{end}}] , a past question is assigned a timestamp t > t end t>t_{\mathrm{end}} , requiring the model to retrospectively recall an event that has already occurred. A real-time question is assigned a timestamp t ∈ [ t start , t end ] t\in[t_{\mathrm{start}},t_{\mathrm{end}}] , such that the target event is ongoing when the question is asked. A future question is assigned a timestamp t < t start t<t_{\mathrm{start}} , requiring the model either to anticipate a future event from the available context or to abstain from answering when the observed evidence is insufficient. The exact question timestamp is then randomly sampled from the temporal range corresponding to the selected timestamp type.
We use Qwen3.5-122B-A10B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the Question Generator . For question generation, we launch four parallel workers, each serving one Qwen3.5-122B-A10B instance with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) on two H200 GPUs.

腾讯一代. 我们首先促使“问题生成器”为目标事件生成一个新的问题,条件是完整视频、事件描述及其相应的时间间隔。 通过观察完整的视频,问题生成器可以同时利用目标事件及其周围的视觉背景来构建一个基于视频内容的问题. 即时器明确控制提问类型,从四个类别中抽取:无限制,多选择,是/否,和计数问题. 与每个产生的问题一起,问题生成器还生成一个预期答案,随后用于核查阶段。
为了涵盖不同的时间推理情景,我们将每个问题从三个类别(过去、实时和未来)中进一步指定随机抽样的提问时间戳类型。 鉴于一个跨越间隔[ t start, t end] [ t_{\mathrm{ start}}, t_{\mathrm{end}}] 的目标事件, 一个过去的问题被分配到一个时间戳 t > t>端 t>mathrm{end}}, 要求模型回顾已经发生的事件. 实时问题被分配到一个时间戳 t QQ [t start, t end] t\ in [t_{\mathrm{ start}}, t_{\mathrm{end}}],这样当问题被问到时目标事件正在持续. 未来的问题被分配到一个时间戳 t < t start t < t_{\ mathrm{ start} , 要求模型要么从现有上下文中预测未来的事件,要么在观察到的证据不充分时不回答。 然后从与选定的时间戳类型相对应的时间范围中随机抽取准确的问题时间戳.
我们使用Quen3.5-122B-A10B (Quen Team, 2026)作为问号生成器. 对于问题生成,我们推出四个平行的工人,每人在两个H200GPU上服务一个Quen3.5-122B-A10B例,使用vLLM(Kwon等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Answer Generation. After obtaining the generated questions and their corresponding timestamps t t , we prompt the Answer Generator to produce a model answer using only the video content observable up to time t t . This setup ensures that the generated answer respects the streaming setting and does not access visual information occurring after the question timestamp. We use Qwen3.5-122B-A10B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the Answer Generator . For answer generation, we launch four parallel workers, each serving one Qwen3.5-122B-A10B instance with vLLM on two H200 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 答众生成. 在获得生成的问题及其相应的时间戳 t 之后,我们促使 Answer generator 制作一个模型解答,只使用可观察到时间 t 的视频内容. 此设置可确保生成的答案尊重流派设置,不访问问题时间戳后发生的视觉信息. 我们使用Quen3.5-122B-A10B (Quen Team, 2026)作为答题生成器. 对于回答生成,我们推出四个平行的工人,每个工人在两个H200GPU上服务一个Quen3.5-122B-A10B实例,并带有vLLM.

blocks.en: Verification. After obtaining the generated question and its corresponding model answer , we prompt the Verifier to assess the quality of the generated question–answer pair. The Verifier takes as input the generated question, the expected answer , the model answer , and the original event description used during question generation. It evaluates both whether the generated question is valid and well grounded in the target event and whether the model answer is consistent with the available evidence. In particular, a substantial mismatch between the expected answer and the model answer may indicate either that the generated question is ambiguous or unreasonable, or that the model answer is incorrect. The original event description provides additional grounding information that allows the Verifier to distinguish between these cases and assess the overall validity of the question–answer pair. For verification, we launch two parallel workers, each serving one Qwen3.5-397B-A17B instance with vLLM on four H200 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 核查。 在获得生成的问题及其相应的模型答案后,我们请验证者评估生成的问答对的质量。 验证器将生成的问题、预期答案、模型答案和在生成问题期间使用的原始事件描述作为输入。 它既评价所产生的问题是否有效,是否在目标事件中有良好的基础,也评价模型答案是否符合现有证据。 特别是,预期答案和模型答案之间的重大不匹配可能表明产生的问题要么模棱两可,要么是不合理的,或者模型答案是不正确的. 最初的事件描述提供了额外的基础信息,使验证人能够区分这些情况,评估问答对齐的总体有效性. 为了核实,我们启动了两个平行的工人,每人服务一个Quen3.5-397B-A17B例,在四个H200GPU上使用vLLM.

blocks.en:
Filtering and Post-Processing. We discard question–answer pairs for which the Verifier identifies an inconsistency between the expected answer and the model answer , determines that the model answer is incorrect, or judges the generated question to be invalid, ambiguous, or otherwise unreasonable. After filtering, we group questions associated with the same video and question timestamp into multi-turn conversations, which are subsequently used for training.
We also include annotations from the offline video understanding from LLaVA-Video-178K to further strengthen the memory mechanism.
blocks.zh:
过滤和后处理。 我们丢弃了问题答案对,而验证者确定预期答案和模型答案不一致,确定模型答案不正确,或者判断产生的问题无效、模棱两可或其他不合理。 在过滤后,我们将与同一视频和问题时间戳相关的问题分组为多回合对话,随后用于培训.
我们还包括LLaVA-Video-178K的离线视频理解的说明,以进一步加强内存机制.

blocks.en: In this section, we provide additional experiment details for the main experiments presented in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们提供了表1所列主要实验的补充实验细节。

blocks.en:
Base Models. In the main experiments, we build MaLoW on top of four different models, VideoChat3-4B ( Li et al., 2026 ) , Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , and MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
VideoChat3 is a video-centric VLM that is further fine-tuned on streaming video understanding data and adopts a full self-attention architecture.
Qwen3-VL-4B is a general-purpose VLM based on a full self-attention architecture.
Qwen3.5 is a general-purpose VLM based on a hybrid attention architecture, where a self-attention layer is interleaved with every four linear-attention layers.
MOSS-VL is a video-centric VLM that adapts cross-attention layers to inject visual information into the text tokens, and a cross-attention layer is interleaved with every four self-attention layers.
blocks.zh:
基地模型报. 在主要实验中,我们搭建了MALOW在四个不同型号之上,即VideoChat3-4B(Li等人,2026年),Qune3-VL-4B(Bai等人,2025年),Qune3.5-9B(Quen Team,2026年),以及MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B(Wang等人,2026年).
视频 Chat3是一个以视频为中心的VLM,在流媒体视频理解数据上进行了进一步的微调,并采用了完整的自留心架构.
Qune3-VL-4B是一种基于完全自觉架构的通用VLM.
Quen3.5是一种基于混合关注结构的通用VLM,其中自留层与每四个线性关注层互换.
MOSS-VL是一种以视频为中心的VLM,它改造了交叉关注层,将视觉信息注入文字符号中,一个交叉关注层与每四个自我关注层互换.

blocks.en:
Video Preprocessing. During training and evaluation, we sample the video frames at 1 fps, dividing the video frames into non-overlapping two-frame temporal blocks (each C t C_{t} is a 2-second video clip). We regard the most recent 2-second block as the current observation, which will be sent into the VLMs, while all the rest of the history frames will be sent into the MaLoW to be converted into LoRA weights.
For MaLoW (Qwen3-VL-4B), we observe that using longer current-observation windows consistently improves performance on the real-time and backward splits of OVO-Bench ( Niu et al., 2025 ) and StreamingBench ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . We therefore use the most recent 8-second clips as the current observations for MaLoW (Qwen3-VL-4B), while the other MaLoW instantiations in the table use the most recent 2 seconds. We hypothesize that these findings, MaLoW (Qwen3-VL-4B) benefiting from longer current-observation windows and the particularly strong performance on StreamingBench, are largely attributable to differences in the architecture and pretraining recipe of the underlying VLMs.
We preprocess the video frames with the preprocessor from the corresponding VLMs, with the maximum per-frame pixel budget set to 262,144 for all three versions of MaLoW .
blocks.zh:
视频预处理. 在训练和评价期间,我们以1英尺的高度对视频帧进行取样,将视频帧分为非重叠的两帧时间块(每个C t C_{t}是一个2秒的视频剪辑). 我们认为最近的2秒块是目前的观察,它将被送入VLM,而其余历史框架将被送入MaLOW,转换成LORA重量.
对于MaLOW(Quen3-VL-4B),我们观察到,使用较长的电流观测窗口持续改善OVO-Bench(Niu等人,2025年)和Streaming Bench(Lin等人,2026年)的实时和后向分裂的性能. 因此,我们使用最新的8秒片段作为MaLOW(Qune3-VL-4B)的当前观测数据,而表中的其他MaLOW即时片段则使用最新的2秒. 我们假设这些发现,MaLOW(Qune3-VL-4B)受益于较长的当前观测窗口和Streaming Bench上特别强的性能,这在很大程度上归因于基本VLM的架构和预训配方的差异.
我们用对应的VLM预处理器预处理视频帧,每个帧的最大像素预算设定为262,144,所有三个版本的MaLOW.

blocks.en: Vision Encoder. We use the vision encoder from the corresponding VLMs as the vision encoder to encode each of the temporal blocks into vision tokens. We also use the MLP layers or adaptor from the VLMs to convert the vision tokens into the text semantic space before we send them into the Aggregator. We denote the vision tokens from the temporal block at t t as V t V_{t} .

blocks.en: Aggregator. Visual tokens V t V_{t} in the temporal block at t t are concatenated with the learnable queries Q Q and the corresponding text embedding T t T_{t} of the timestamp of the temporal block. These tokens are first projected to a hidden dimension of 512 and processed by a four-layer Transformer encoder aggregator with eight attention heads (64 dimensions per head), a feed-forward dimension of 2,048, pre-layer normalization, GELU activations. We learn one 512-dimensional query for each of the VLM decoder layers. The query is shared across target modules, and LoRA ranks in the same VLM decoder layer.

blocks.en: State-Space Model. We learn a four-layer DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2024 ) with a hidden dimension of 512 as the state-space model. Each DeltaNet layer uses four value heads and two key heads, both with head dimension 128.

LoRA Application Location. For VideoChat3-4B, we apply rank-8 generated LoRA for the MLP projections ( gate_proj , up_proj , and down_proj ) and self_attn.v_proj in every attention layer.
For the Qwen3-VL-4B, we apply rank-8 generated LoRA for the MLP projections ( gate_proj , up_proj , down_proj ), and self_attn.v_proj in every attention layer.
For Qwen3.5-9B, we apply rank-8 generated LoRA for the MLP projections ( gate_proj , up_proj , and down_proj ) in every attention layer, self_attn.v_proj in full-attention layers, and linear_attn.in_proj_qkv in linear-attention layers.
For MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B, we apply rank-8 generated LoRA for the MLP projections ( gate_proj , up_proj , and down_proj ), and v_proj in every attention layer. We inject the generated LoRA weights into the target linear layers of the frozen base model through customized forward functions.

LoRA 应用程序位置 。 对于VideoChat3-4B,我们应用八级生成的LORA来进行MLP预测(gate_proj, up_proj,和 down_proj),以及每个关注层的自_attn.v_proj.
对于Qwen3-VL-4B,我们应用八级生成的LORA用于MLP预测(gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj),以及每个关注层的自-atn.v_proj.
对于Wen3.5-9B,我们应用八级生成的LORA,用于每个关注层的MLP预测(gate_proj, up_proj,和 down_proj),自-atn.v_proj在全注层,线性-atn.in_proj_qkv在线性关注层.

blocks.en:
Training Details. We build our training pipeline on top of the Llama-Factory ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) .
We train MaLoW on the MaLoW -Instruct dataset introduced in Section 3.4 for 2,800 optimization steps with a total batch size of 64. Training uses four H200s, a per-device batch size of one, and 16 gradient-accumulation steps. We use AdamW with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}=0.999 , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} , an peak learning rate of 8 × 10 − 5 8\times 10^{-5} , a cosine learning-rate schedule, and a warm-up ratio of 0.1 0.1 . Training is performed in bfloat16. We set the LoRA regularization factor γ \gamma to 0.01.

blocks.en: During training, we use the state-space model in its parallel causal form. For each sample, the compact vision representations q t q_{t} are arranged in chronological order and processed by the four-layer DeltaNet using the chunk-parallel gated-delta-rule kernel and an attention mask for padded blocks. We then select the output at the last valid temporal block for each history observation. This parallel computation is causally equivalent to processing the blocks recurrently while carrying the convolutional and recurrent DeltaNet states, which is the form that is used for online streaming inference.
blocks.zh: 在训练期间,我们采用状态-空间模型的平行因果形式。 对于每个样本,紧凑的视觉表示q t q_{t}按时间顺序排列,由四层的DeltaNet使用块平行的门-德尔塔规则内核和加固块的注意罩处理. 然后我们为每次历史观测选择最后一个有效的时间块的输出. 这种平行计算在因果上相当于在承载演化和反复的DeltaNet状态时经常处理块,这是用于在线流推论的形式.

blocks.en: Evaluation Details. Following the evaluation protocols adopted in prior streaming video understanding works ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , we evaluate MaLoW on the Real-Time split of StreamingBench ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , as well as the Real-Time and Backward splits of OVO-Bench ( Niu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 评价细节。 根据之前流媒体理解作品(Shen等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年a)中采纳的评价协议,我们评价了MaLOW关于流媒体奔奇实时分裂(Lin等人,2026年),以及OVO-Bench实时和后向分裂(Niu等人,2025年).

blocks.en: For StreamingBench, we evaluate on the Real-Time split, which contains 2,500 multiple-choice questions, and use accuracy as metric. For OVO-Bench, both the Backward and Real-Time splits are evaluated with the metric accuracy. The Backward and Real-Time splits consist of 631 and 837 questions. Following prior work, the performance of each split is computed as the macro-average across the tasks belonging to that split, and we additionally report the macro-average performance across the Backward and Real-Time splits in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 对于Streaming Bench,我们评价实时拆分,其中包含2500个多选择问题,并以精确度作为度量. 对OVO-Bench来说,对后向和实时的拆分都进行精确度评价。 后向和实时分拆包括631和837个问题. 继先前的工作之后,每次拆分的性能作为属于该拆分的任务的宏观平均值计算,我们又在表1中报告后向和实时拆分的宏观平均性能。

blocks.en: The Backward splits of OVO-Bench mostly focus on retrospect to the past and comprise three tasks: Episodic Memory (EPM), Action Sequence Identification (ASI), and Hallucination Detection (HLD). Among them, EPM is particularly well suited for evaluating the memory mechanism introduced by MaLoW , as it directly measures the model’s ability to retain and retrieve information from earlier observations. We further note that HLD is relatively less challenging because all ground-truth responses are Unable to answer . As a result, models can achieve high accuracy on this task by consistently predicting this response, making HLD less discriminative for assessing the effectiveness of long-term memory mechanisms.
blocks.zh: OVO-Bench的后向分裂主要侧重于回顾过去,包含三项任务:Episodic内存(EPM),动作序列识别(ASI),和幻觉检测(HLD). 其中,EPM特别适合评价MaLOW引入的内存机制,因为它直接衡量模型保留和检索早期观测信息的能力. 我们还注意到,高代办的挑战性相对较低,因为所有地面真相反应都无法回答。 因此,模型可以通过始终如一地预测这种响应来达到这项任务的高精度,使得HLD在评估长期内存机制的有效性方面不那么具有歧视性.

blocks.en: The trained MaLoW can operate in a fully streaming manner by processing the video history block by block using the cached-forward mode of DeltaNet. (Please see the Evaluation details. in the section C.2 ) To accelerate evaluation, however, we use the same parallel-forward mode employed during training when evaluating on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench. Specifically, for a question associated with a video prefix [ 0 , T ] [0,T] , we treat the interval [ 0 , T − 2 ] [0,T-2] as historical context and sample it at 1 fps as input to the hypernetwork. The base VLM then receives the question together with two frames sampled from the current observation window [ T − 2 , T ] [T-2,T] . For the evaluation on the OVO-bench, we follow the prompt example used in lmms-eval ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and for the evaluation on the StreamingBench we follow the prompt example used in the official repository.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的MaLOW可以通过使用DeltaNet的缓存前导模式通过块处理视频历史块来以全流方式运行. (详见C.2节) 不过,为了加快评价,我们在评价OVO-Bench和Streating Bench时采用了培训时采用的平行模式。 具体地说,对于一个与视频前缀[0,T][0,T]相关的问题,我们把间隔[0,T−2][0,T−2]当作历史背景,并在1英尺处进行取样,作为超网络的输入. 然后,基础VLM连同从当前观测窗口取样的两个框架[T−2,T][T-2,T]一起收到问题。 关于OVO-bench的评价,我们遵循lmms-eval(Zhang等人,2025年a)中使用的迅速例子,关于Streaming Bench的评价,我们遵循官方寄存器中使用的迅速例子。

blocks.en: Baselines Re-Evaluation. Among the baselines in Table 1 , we re-evaluate MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , VideoChat3-4B ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , as these models are also used as the base VLMs for MaLoW . For the remaining baselines, we report the results from their original papers.
blocks.zh: 重新评估。 在表1中的基线中,我们重新评估最低业务安全标准-甚低频-实时-11B(Wang等人,2026年),视频Chat3-4B (Li et al., 2026),以及Quen3.5-9B(Quen Team, 2026),因为这些型号也被用作MaLOW的基础VLM. 关于其余的基线,我们报告其原始文件的结果。

blocks.en: For Qwen3.5-9B, we sample video frames at 1 fps with a maximum per-frame pixel budget of 262,144 and use greedy decoding for answer generation.
blocks.zh: 对于Quen3.5-9B,我们在1 fps对视频帧进行抽样,每帧最大像素预算为262,144,并使用贪婪的解码来生成答案.

blocks.en: For VideoChat3-4B, we use the official evaluation code and follow the hyperparameters reported in the paper. On OVO-Bench, we sample frames at 2 fps and retain the 32 most recent frames, with a per-frame pixel budget of 448 2 448^{2} and a visual-token budget of 80K. On StreamingBench, we sample frames at 4 fps with at most 4,096 frames, using the same per-frame pixel budget of 448 2 448^{2} and visual-token budget of 80K.
blocks.zh: 对于VideoChat3-4B,我们使用官方的评价代码,并遵循论文中报告的超参数. 在OVO-Bench上,我们以2 fps为样本帧并保留最近32个帧,每个帧的像素预算为448 2 448\2}和可视化的80K预算. 在"奔驰"上,我们用最多4,096帧的4fps进行取样框架,使用448 2,448^{2}的每帧像素预算以及80K的可视化预算。

blocks.en: For MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B, as neither the paper nor the released repository provides an official evaluation script, we evaluate the model on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench using frames sampled at 1 fps with a maximum per-frame pixel budget of 262,144.

blocks.en: These settings successfully reproduce the reported OVO-Bench performance of VideoChat3 and MOSS-VL-Realtime. blocks.en: C.2 MaLoW in VLA setting

blocks.en: Base VLA Model and Initialization. Inspired by the previous work ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , we train a simple VLA model on top of Qwen3.5-2B, named as Q3.5-2B-MLP, as the starting point of the MaLoW (Q3.5-2B-MLP).
blocks.zh: 基础VLA模式与初始化. 受前作(张等,2026b)的启发,我们在Quen3.5-2B上方训练了一个简单的VLA模型,命名为Q3.5-2B-MLP,作为MaLOW(Q3.5-2B-MLP)的起点.

blocks.en:
The Q3.5-2B-MLP is given the current observation (an image) and text instruction and predicts a chunk of four seven-dimensional actions, corresponding to the current action and the following three actions.
We learn special tokens as action hidden representations, and VLMs compress the visual observation and the text instruction into the special tokens.
An action decoder, which is a two-layer MLP that directly regresses normalized robot actions using mean-squared error based on the special tokens.
We use the Qwen3.5 preprocessor to preprocess the input image and the text instruction.
blocks.zh:
Q3.5-2B-MLP被赋予当前观察(一个图像)和文本指示,并预测了一组四个七维动作,对应当前动作和以下三个动作.
我们学习特殊符号作为动作隐藏的表示,VLMs将视觉观察和文字指示压缩为特殊符号.
动作解码器,是一种双层的MLP,使用基于特殊符号的均匀误差,直接递归常态机器人动作.
我们使用 Quen3.5 预处理器来预处理输入图像和文本指令 。

blocks.en:
Q3.5-2B-MLP was trained on the Bridge and RT-1 mixture of the OXE LeRobot dataset ( O’Neill et al., 2024 ) for 50,000 optimization steps, with learning rate is 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} on action decoder, and 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} on LoRA. The learning rate is linearly warmed up for 5,000 steps and then cosine-decayed.
Training uses AdamW with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} ,and weight decay 10 − 8 10^{-8} .
Training is conducted in bfloat16 on four H200 GPUs with a per-device batch size of 16 and two gradient-accumulation steps, yielding a global batch size of 128.
We apply rank-128 LoRA to all linear layers, including the vision tower and multimodal projector, with a scaling factor of 256. Q3.5-2B-MLP achieves 59.4% in the Simpler-Bridge with WidowX robot.

Q3.5-2B-MLP在OXE LeRobot数据集(O ' Neill 等人,2024年)的桥和RT-1混合物上接受了5万个优化步骤的培训,学习速度为动作解码器4×10−5 4×4×5,动作解码器1×10×4 1×4 10×4). 学习速率线性加热,达到5000步,然后余弦消退.

以bfloat16方式对四个H200GPU进行培训,每个装置的批量尺寸为16个,两个梯度积累步骤,全球批量尺寸为128个。
我们对所有线性层,包括视塔和多式投影仪,适用一级128LORA,缩放系数为256。 Q3.5-2B-MLP与WiverX机器人在Simmer-Bridge中实现59.4%.

Evaluation Details. We evaluate MaLoW (Q3.5-2B-MLP) on the four WidowX Bridge tasks in SimplerEnv:

评价细节。 我们评价MaLOW(Q3.5-2B-MLP),

blocks.en: Evaluation is conducted in a fully interactive streaming setting. At environment step zero, no historical context is available, and the model exactly reproduces the Q3.5-2B-MLP policy. At each subsequent step, completed two-frame blocks and the corresponding actions are permanently incorporated into the cached DeltaNet state m t m_{t} and updated into the global sematic s t s_{t} . If the history ends with an unpaired frame, we duplicate it to form a provisional block and generate the current adapter using a temporary copy of the recurrent state. At the next step, we discard this temporary update and incorporate the completed two-frame block into the persistent state. The h t h_{t} state is reset at each episode boundary.
blocks.zh: 评价是在完全互动的流程环境中进行的。 在环境步骤0,没有历史背景,模型完全复制了Q3.5-2B-MLP政策. 在接下来的每一个步骤,完成的双帧块和相应的动作被永久纳入缓存的DeltaNet状态 m t m_{t}并更新到全局的sematic s t s_{t}. 如果历史以未发光的框架结束,我们重复它形成一个临时块,并使用重复状态的临时副本生成当前适配器. 下一步,我们放弃这一临时更新,将已完成的两帧块纳入持久性状态。 h t h_{t] 状态在每集边界重设.

blocks.en: The policy predicts four-action chunks and applies action ensembling over a horizon of four steps. Because ensembling may cause the action executed by the environment to differ from the most recent raw model prediction, we feed the normalized executed action back to the policy server. This executed action, rather than the unensembled model prediction, is paired with the corresponding observation when constructing subsequent history blocks.
blocks.zh: 该政策预测了四个行动块,并应用了四个步骤。 因为综艺可能导致环境所执行的动作与最近的原始模型预测不同,所以我们把已正常执行的动作反馈给政策服务器. 这个已执行的动作,而不是未组合的模型预测,在构建后续历史块时,会与相应的观测配合.

blocks.en: In this section, we provide additional implementation details for the results presented in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们提供了表4所列结果的更多执行细节。

blocks.en: Base Models. In this sections, we use the Gemma-E4B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) and Qwen3.5-0.8B, Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the base model.
blocks.zh: 基地模型报. 本节使用Gemma-E4B(Gemma Team,2026年)和Quen3.5-0.8B,Quen3.5-2B和Quen3.5-4B. (Quen Team, 2026)作为基建模式.

blocks.en:
LoRA Application Location. For Gemma-E4B, we apply rank-8 generated LoRA for the MLP projections ( gate_proj , up_proj , and down_proj ) in every attention layer.
For Qwen3.5 series, we apply rank-8 generated LoRA for the MLP projections ( gate_proj , up_proj , and down_proj ) in every attention layer, self_attn.v_proj in full-attention layers, and linear_attn.in_proj_qkv in linear-attention layers.
blocks.zh:
LoRA 应用程序位置 。 对于Gemma-E4B,我们应用八级生成的LORA用于每个关注层的MLP预测(gate_proj, up_proj,和 down_proj).
对于 Quen3.5 系列,我们应用 排名 8 生成的 LORA 用于 MLP 预测 (gate_proj, up_proj,和 down_proj ) 在每个关注层中,自我_attn.v_proj 完全关注层,线性_atn.in_proj_qkv 在线性关注层中.

blocks.en: Data, Structural, and Training Details. For the Video Preprocessing, Vision Encoder, Aggregator, State-Space Model, Cosine-similarity-based gating, the Converter, and Training details are share the same details in section C.1 .
blocks.zh: 数据、结构和培训细节。 关于视频预处理、视觉编码器、聚合器、国家空间模型、基于同位素的吉卜赛、转换器和培训细节,在C.1节中也有同样的细节。

blocks.en:
Evaluation Details. For the evaluation on the OVO-bench, we follow the example used in lmms-eval ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and for the evaluation on the StreamingBench we follow the example used in the official repository.
For a question associated with video prefix [ 0 , T ] [0,T] , the interval [ 0 , T − 2 ] [0,T-2] is treated as historical context and sampled at 1 fps for the MaLoW . The base VLM receives the question together with two frames sampled from the current observation [ T − 2 , T ] [T-2,T] .
blocks.zh:
评价细节。 关于OVO-bench的评价,我们效仿lmms-eval(张等人,2025年a)中使用的例子,关于Streaming Bench的评价,我们仿效官方寄存器中使用的例子。
对于一个与视频前缀[0,T][0,T]相关的问题,间隔[0,T−2][0,T−2]被作为历史背景处理,并在1 fps中为MaLOW取样. 碱基VLM与从当前观测中取样的两个帧一起收到问题[T−2,T][T-2,T].

blocks.en: For OVO-Bench, we evaluate all backward, real-time, and forward splits. Backward and real-time questions are scored by accuracy. For the forward split, repetitive-event counting is scored by exact count matching, while sequential-step recognition and contextual-readiness recognition are scored using exact accuracy. We follow the benchmark’s macro-averaging protocol across tasks for each split, and we further present the macro-averaging number over 3 splits.
blocks.zh: 对于OVO-Bench,我们评价所有的落后,实时,和前向分裂. 后向和实时的问题通过准确性得分. 对于前向分数,重复事件计数通过精确的计数比对得分,而顺序步骤识别和上下文准备状态识别则使用精确的精确度计数. 我们遵循每个拆分任务的基准宏观验证协议,我们进一步提出3个拆分的宏观验证数字。

blocks.en: For StreamingBench, we evaluate the Real, Omni, Sequential-QA, and Proactive subsets base on how the benchmark annotations are organized. Real, Omni, and Sequential-QA are scored by accuracy. Following the original protocol, Sequential-QA includes the gold question–answer history from earlier timestamps in the same video. For Proactive evaluation, the model is queried once per second until four seconds after the annotated trigger time. An example is counted as correct only when the model triggers within this tolerance window, and its generated response contains the expected output. The overall StreamingBench score is the benchmark-weighted average over Real, Omni, Proactive, and Sequential-QA, using weights of 2,500, 1,500, 250, and 250 examples, respectively.
blocks.zh: 就Streaming Bench而言,我们评价Real、Omni、Sequentive-QA和主动子集的基础是基准说明的组织方式。 Real,Omni,和Sequentive-QA都是通过精度得分. 根据原始协议,Sequentive-QA将早期时间戳的黄金问答历史包含在同一视频中. 对于主动评价,每秒询问一次模型,直到附加说明的触发时间之后4秒. 一个例子只有在模型触发在这个容忍窗口内时才会被计算为正确,其生成的响应包含预期输出. 整体Streaming Bench分数是比Real,Omni,Preaction,和Sequentive-QA的基准加权平均值,分别使用2500,1500,250和250例的权重.

blocks.zh: C.4 联合国 记忆压力测试

blocks.en: In this section, we share additional implementation details for the memory stress test evaluation and the results presented in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们分享了内存压力测试评价和表4所列结果的更多执行细节。

blocks.en: We use the StreamArena ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) Historical Retrospection (HR) split as the benchmark, which has 877 questions across L1–L4 over 237 videos. L1 to L4 indicate the evidence-to-query gap of less than 5 min, between 5 and 15 min, between 15 and 30 min, and longer than 30 min, respectively.
blocks.zh: 以StreamArena(张等,2026d)历史回顾(HR)为基准, L1至L4分别表示5分钟以下,5分钟至15分钟,15分钟至30分钟,30分钟以上的证据对清空.

blocks.en: We compare MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) against strong streaming video understanding models: MOSS-VL-Realtime-11B ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , which retains the full historical context; VideoChat3-4B ( Li et al., 2026 ) and AURA-8B ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , which operates with a local 16 / 30 -second observation window, respectively; VST-7B ( Guan et al., 2026 ) , which compresses the historical observation as text-based memory.
blocks.zh: 我们比较MaLOW(Quen3.5-9B)与强流视频理解模型: 最低业务安全标准 -- -- VL -- -- Realtime-11B (Wang等人,2026年),保留了完整的历史背景;VideoChat3-4B(Li等人,2026年)和AURA-8B(Lu等人,2026年),分别以本地16/30-秒观测窗口运行;VST-7B(Guan等人,2026年),压缩历史观察作为文字记忆.

blocks.en:
For AURA and VST, we follow the official implementations in StreamArena to evaluate the model performance. For MOSS-VL-Realtime, VideoChat3, and MaLoW , they share the same question prompt derived from the prompt used by AURA. MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) samples video frames at 1fps with a maximum per-frame pixel budget of 262,144. The final two-second window is regarded as the current observation and will be sent to the VLMs, while the rest of the history frames will be sent to the MaLoW and converted into LoRA. The VideoChat3 uses 32 unique frames at 2 FPS from the latest 16 seconds, with an aspect-ratio-preserving maximum of 200,704 pixels per frame ( 448 2 448^{2} ). MOSS-VL samples frames at 1 FPS and with maximum per-frame pixel cap as 262,144 pixels. VST uses up to 384 causal-prefix frames at 1 FPS with aspect-ratio-preserving resolution determined dynamically by its 8,192-visual-token-per-segment budget.
AURA takes most recent 30 seconds video at 1 FPS as input, with per-frame max pixel 602,112 pixel.
blocks.zh:
对于AURA和VST,我们跟踪StreamArena的正式执行,以评价模型性能. 对于MOSS-VL-Realtime,VideoChat3和MALOW来说,他们共享来自AURA使用的迅速的相同的问题提示. MaLOW(Quen3.5-9B)在1fps采集视频帧样本,每帧最大像素预算为262,144. 最终的两秒窗口被视为目前的观测结果,并将发送到VLM,其余历史帧则会发送到MaLOW并转换为LORA. VideoChat3从最近16秒起在2个FPS上使用32个独特的帧,每个帧最大可保持200,704像素(448 2 448^{2}). MOSS-VL样本框架为1 FPS,最大每帧像素上限为262,144像素. VST在1 FPS上使用最多384个因果前缀框架,其维度-RATIO-保留分辨率由8,192-每个部分的视距预算动态确定.
AURA将最近30秒的视频在1 FPS作为输入,每帧最大像素602,112像素.

blocks.en: C.5 Streaming Inference Speed Profiling
blocks.zh: C.5 流线推论速度分析

blocks.en: We provide additional details on the inference-speed profiling reported in Figure 4 . We measure the streaming inference latency of MaLoW and four baselines on 100 deterministically sampled OVO-Bench ( Niu et al., 2025 ) questions spanning a wide range of history lengths. Video durations range from 8 to 1,117 seconds, with a median of 153.5 seconds, a mean of 193.3 seconds, and a 90th percentile of 312 seconds. This set includes both short clips and videos exceeding 10 minutes, enabling evaluation of long-context streaming efficiency. At each query timestamp t t , we measure synchronized GPU computation required to process the current observation and answer the query under each method’s native streaming protocol. Video decoding, resizing, and other input preprocessing are excluded.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了图4中报告的推论速度剖面图的更多细节。 我们用100个确定性抽样的OVO-Bench(Niu等人,2025年)问题衡量MaLOW的流派推断纬度和4个基线。 视频持续时间从8秒到1,117秒不等,中位数为153.5秒,平均值为193.3秒,第90百分位数为312秒. 该套节目包括短片和超过10分钟的视频,能够评价长文本流效率. 在每次查询时间戳 t t 时, 我们测量同步的 GPU 计算, 处理当前观测结果, 并在每种方法的本地流线协议下回答查询 。 视频解码,重定大小,以及其他输入预处理被排除在外.

blocks.en: For MaLoW , each streaming step includes encoding the current observation, updating the hidden state and generating the LoRA adapter for the next time step, applying the adapter generated for the current time step, prefilling the model with the question and the two most recent frames from [ t − 2 , t ] [t-2,t] , and decoding the first output token.
blocks.zh: 对于MaLOW,每个流线步骤包括编码当前观察,更新隐藏状态和生成LORA适配器作为下一个时间步骤,应用当前时间步骤生成的适配器,预先将问题和两个最近帧从[t−2,t][t-2,t]中填充,并解码第一个输出符.

blocks.en: For SimpleStream (Qwen3.5-9B), the model receives only the question and two frames sampled from the most recent two-second window, [ t − 2 , t ] [t-2,t] , without earlier visual history. The measured latency includes prefilling with these inputs and decoding the first output token.
blocks.zh: 对于SimpleStream(Quen3.5-9B),模型只收到问题和从最近两秒窗口取样的两个帧,[t−2,t] [t-2,t],没有早期的视觉历史. 测量的延迟性包括预先填充这些输入以及解码第一个输出符.

blocks.en: For Qwen3.5-9B with full context, the measured latency includes prefilling the question together with the complete video history from the start of the stream to t t , sampled at 1 FPS, followed by decoding the first output token.
blocks.zh: 对于具有完整上下文的Quen3.5-9B,测量的延迟包括将问题与从溪流开始到t t的完整视频历史一起进行预填,在1 FPS进行抽样,然后对第一个输出符进行解码.

blocks.en: For VideoChat3, we follow its official streaming implementation. At each query, the model re-prefills the question together with a sliding window of the most recent 32 frames, corresponding to approximately 16 seconds at 2 FPS, before generating the streaming response. The measured latency includes prefilling of the local window video and text query and subsequent decoding.
blocks.zh: 对于视频 查特3号,我们跟踪其正式执行 在每次查询时,模型会重新将问题与最近32帧的滑动窗口一起进行预置,对应于2 FPS时约16秒,然后生成流化响应. 测量的延迟包括预填本地窗口视频和文本查询以及随后的解码.

blocks.en: For MOSS-VL-Realtime, we follow its official streaming implementation, in which incoming observations are continuously incorporated into a growing vision-text KV state. The measured latency includes the forward pass required to ingest the latest two seconds of video and the subsequent decoding.
blocks.zh: 对于MOSS-VL-Realtime,我们跟踪其正式的流派执行,其中不断将即将到来的观测纳入日益壮大的视觉文本KV状态. 测量到的延迟包括摄入最新两秒视频所需的前传和随后的解码.
