blocks.zh: 附录D 其他实验

blocks.en: D.1 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: D.1 读取研究

blocks.en:
We conduct ablation studies with MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) to investigate key design choices: (1) the LoRA target modules, (2) the LoRA rank, (3) the architecture of the MaLoW ,
(4) the size of the current observation and (5) the refresh rate of the hidden state.
All ablations are conducted on a subset of an subset of the training data described in Section 3.4 , rather than the final dataset used for the main experiments.
Within each ablation, all training hyperparameters are kept fixed following Section 4.1 , except for the component being ablated, ensuring a controlled comparison. We report results on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench, together with the Episodic Memory (EPM) results from OVO-Bench.
blocks.zh:
我们与MaLOW(Quen3.5-9B)进行开发研究,以调查关键设计选择:(1)LORA目标模块,(2)LORA级别,(3)MALOW的架构.
(4)当前观测的大小和(5)隐藏状态的刷新率.
所有拼贴都是在第3.4节所述培训数据的一个子集上进行的,而不是用于主要实验的最后数据集。
在每次试验中,所有训练超参数都按照第4.1节固定,除非部件减速,确保有控制的比较。 我们报告OVO-Bench和Streaming Bench的成果,以及OVO-Bench的Episodic记忆(EPM)成果.

blocks.en: Where should LoRA be applied? Qwen3.5-9B adopts a hybrid attention architecture in which one self-attention layer is interleaved with every four linear-attention layers, providing a representative setting for studying LoRA placement in modern hybrid-attention VLMs. We evaluate three cumulative configurations: (1) applying LoRA only to the MLP layers shared by both self-attention and linear-attention blocks; (2) additionally applying LoRA to the v_proj in self-attention layers; and (3) further applying LoRA to the qkv_proj in linear-attention layers. As shown in Table 10 , progressively extending LoRA to additional modules consistently improves the average performance, with the best results achieved when all three module types are adapted.
blocks.zh: LORA应在哪里适用? Quen3.5-9B采用混合关注结构,其中自留层与每四个线性关注层相间,为研究LORA在现代混合关注VLM中的放置提供了代表性的设置. 我们评价三种累积构型:(1)将LORA仅适用于自注意和线性观察区块共用的MLP层;(2)将LORA额外应用于自注意层的v_proj;(3)将LORA进一步应用于线性观察层的qkv_proj. 如表10所示,逐步将LORA扩展至其他模块,持续改善平均业绩,并在调整所有三个模块类型时取得最佳成果。

blocks.en: What is the best LoRA rank? The results are presented in Table 10 . Among the evaluated configurations, rank 8 achieves the best overall performance, with an average score of 69.2. Rank 4 performs slightly worse, suggesting limited adaptation capacity, whereas increasing the rank to 16 causes a substantial performance drop on both benchmarks, indicating overfitting.
blocks.zh: 最好的洛拉军衔是多少? 调查结果见表10。 在被评价的配置中,第8名取得了最佳的整体表现,平均得分69.2. 排名4的表现略差,表明适应能力有限,而将排名提高到16,造成两个基准的绩效大幅下降,表明适应能力过度。

blocks.en: Table 9: Ablation study on the modules to which LoRA is applied. Each row cumulatively adds LoRA to the module indicated in the first column.
blocks.zh: 表9:关于应用LORA的模块的研究。 每行累计将LORA添加到第一列所示的模块中.

blocks.en: Table 10: Ablation study on the learned LoRA rank.
blocks.zh: 表10:关于学习的LORA等级的研究。

blocks.en: What is the best MaLoW module structure? We investigate key design choices for the MaLoW module: (1) whether temporal modeling with a State-Space Model (SSM) and global semantic aggregation are both necessary, and (2) how global semantics should be effectively preserved.
blocks.zh: 什么是最好的MaLOW模块结构? 我们调查了MaLOW模块的关键设计选择:(1) 是否有必要使用国空间模型(SSM)和全球语义汇总的时间模型,以及(2) 如何有效保存全球语义。

blocks.en: Table 12 evaluates the contributions of the SSM and global semantic aggregation. The w/ sum variant achieves stronger performance on EPM, which emphasizes information from earlier observations, whereas the w/ SSM variant performs better on StreamingBench, where a large portion of the evaluation focuses on real-time understanding. These results suggest that the SSM is particularly effective at modeling temporally local and causal information, while global semantic aggregation better preserves information over longer temporal horizons. Combining both components balances real-time understanding and long-term memory, yielding the best overall performance.
blocks.zh: 表12评价了高级管理制度和全球语义汇总的贡献。 w/sum变体在EPM上取得了更强的性能,它强调来自早期观测的信息,而w/SSM变体在Streaming Bench上表现更好,其中评价的一大部分侧重于实时理解. 这些结果表明,特别管理系统在模拟时间局部和因果信息方面特别有效,而全球语义汇总则在较长的时间范围内更好地保存信息。 将两个组成部分结合起来,兼顾实时理解和长期记忆,产生最佳的整体表现.

blocks.en: Table 12 further compares different strategies for preserving global semantics. We consider three variants: sum , which directly accumulates all previous compact visual representations q t q_{t} ; weighted sum , which weights each q t q_{t} according to the cosine similarity between adjacent temporal blocks; and gated sum , which selectively retains q t q_{t} based on temporal similarity and is adopted in our final design. The gated sum achieves the best average performance. By filtering temporally redundant representations while retaining informative observations, the gating mechanism preserves global semantics more effectively and improves overall performance.
blocks.zh: 表12还比较了保护全球语义的不同战略。 我们考虑三种变体:总和,它直接累积以前所有紧凑的视觉表现 q t q t};加权和量,它根据相邻时间块之间的余弦相似性,对每个 q t q_{t}进行加权;加闸和量,它根据时间相似性,有选择地保留 q t q_{t} 在我们的最终设计中被采纳. 入门金额实现最佳平均业绩。 通过在保留信息性观察的同时过滤时间上多余的表述,配音机制可以更有效地保存全球语义,提高整体性能.

blocks.en: Table 11: Ablation study on the causal relationship and global semantics.
blocks.zh: 表11:关于因果关系和全球语义的研究.

blocks.en: Table 12: Ablation study on different global semantics aggregation strategies.
blocks.zh: 表12:关于不同全球语义汇总战略的研究。

blocks.en:
How does the size of the current observation affect performance? Although the main experiments in Section 4.1 treat each C t C_{t} as a 2-second video clip, updating the hidden state h t h_{t} every 2 seconds, the observation window can be varied independently of h t h_{t} update frequency. To isolate the effect of the current observation window while keeping the hidden-state update interval fixed, we ablate the window sizes of 1, 2, and 4 seconds, with 2 seconds corresponding to our default setting. For the 4-second window, h t h_{t} is updated using the oldest 2-second segment evicted from the window. For the 1-second window, MaLoW accumulates consecutive observations and updates h t h_{t} after every 2 seconds of newly observed video.
The result is presented in Table 14 . A larger 4-second current observation window improves real-time perception, as reflected by the higher StreamingBench score, but degrades memory performance, with EPM dropping to 60.0. In contrast, a 1-second window reduces real-time perception while yielding similar EPM performance as the 2-second window. To balance real-time perception and long-term memory, we therefore use a 2-second current observation window as the default setting.
blocks.zh:
当前观测的大小如何影响性能?. 虽然第4.1节中的主要实验将每个C t C_{t}作为2秒的视频剪辑,每2秒更新隐藏状态 h t h_{t},但观察窗口可以独立于h t h_{t}更新频率而变化. 为了隔离当前观测窗口的效果,同时保持隐藏状态更新间隔的固定,我们降低窗口大小1,2,4秒,2秒对应我们的默认设置. 对于4秒窗口, h t h_{t} 使用最古老的2秒部分被从窗口中驱逐来更新 。 对于1秒的窗口,MaLOW在每2秒新观测到的视频后,会累积连续的观测并更新h t h_{t}.
结果见表14。 一个更大的4秒的当前观测窗口可以改善实时感知,这表现在更高的Streaming Bench得分,但可以降低内存性能,EPM下降至60.0. 相比之下,1秒窗口会降低实时感知,同时产生类似于2秒窗口的EPM性能. 为了平衡实时感知和长期记忆,我们因此使用2秒的当前观测窗口作为默认设置.

blocks.en: How does the refresh rate of the hidden state affect the performance? Although the main experiments in Section 4.1 treat each C t C_{t} as a 2-second video clip, updating the hidden state h t h_{t} every 2 seconds, the update frequency can be varied independently of the observation window. We therefore conduct an ablation with update intervals of 1, 2 (which used in the main experiments), and 4 seconds while keeping the base VLM input fixed to the most recent 2 seconds. For a 1-second interval, the hidden state is updated using the oldest 1-second segment evicted from the current 2-second observation window; for a 4-second interval, MaLoW accumulates newly observed video and updates the hidden state only after every 4 seconds of new observations.
blocks.zh: 隐藏状态的刷新率如何影响性能? 虽然第4.1节中的主要实验将每个C t C_{t}作为2秒的视频剪辑,每2秒更新隐藏状态 h t h_{t},但更新频率可以独立于观测窗口而变化. 因此,我们进行一个更新间隔为1,2(在主要实验中使用)和4秒的减速,同时将基础VLM输入固定在最近2秒. 对于1秒间隔,使用从当前2秒观测窗口中驱逐出来的最古老的1秒部分更新隐藏状态;对于4秒间隔,MaLOW累积新观测到的视频,仅在每4秒新观测后更新隐藏状态.

blocks.en: The results are presented in Table 14 . We observe that less frequent updates, where each update incorporates a larger temporal chunk, slightly improve memory performance at the cost of a small drop in real-time perception. We hypothesize that this behavior is related to the State-Space Model (SSM) used for hidden-state updates. As shown in Table 12 , the SSM primarily models short-term temporal dependencies. More frequent updates may therefore bias it toward shorter temporal ranges, improving current perception but slightly weakening longer-term memory, while less frequent updates have the opposite effect. Overall, performance remains stable across different update intervals. We therefore adopt a 2-second interval, which balances memory and real-time perception while matching the current observation window for a simpler design.
blocks.zh: 调查结果见表14。 我们注意到,更新次数较少,每次更新都包含一个较大的时间块,在实时感知小幅下降的情况下略微改善内存性能. 我们假设这种行为与用于隐藏状态更新的状态空间模型(SSM)有关. 如表12所示,证监会主要模拟短期时间依赖关系。 因此,更频繁的更新可能倾向于缩短时间范围,改善目前的认知,但略微削弱长期记忆,而较少的更新则会产生相反的效果。 总体而言,不同更新间隔的业绩保持稳定。 因此,我们采用2秒间隔,平衡内存和实时感知,同时匹配目前的观测窗口以进行更简单的设计.

blocks.en: Table 13: Ablation study on the current observation size; frames are sampled at 1fps.
blocks.zh: 表13:当前观测规模的放大研究;帧在1fps取样.

blocks.en: Table 14: Ablation study on the hidden state ( h t h_{t} ) refresh rate; frames are sampled at 1fps.
blocks.zh: 表14:关于隐藏状态(h t h_{t})的缩写研究;帧在1fps进行采样.

blocks.en: D.2 Additional Analysis
blocks.zh: D.2 其他分析

blocks.en: Latency Breakdown. We further analyze the latency of MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) reported in Figure 4 , with the detailed breakdown presented in Table 15 . Encoding the new frames and updating the hidden state h t h_{t} , generating the LoRA tensors A t + 1 A_{t+1} and B t + 1 B_{t+1} , and combining them to construct Δ ​ θ t + 1 \Delta\theta_{t+1} account for 7.9%, 2.1%, and 3.7% of the total latency, respectively. Importantly, these operations compute the adapter for the next temporal block and can therefore be executed in parallel with applying Δ ​ θ t \Delta\theta_{t} and performing base-VLM prefilling and decoding for the current block. With such pipelining, only the application of Δ ​ θ t \Delta\theta_{t} and the wrapper overhead remain on the critical inference path, adding 1.75 ms to the 130.07 ms base-model inference latency. This corresponds to approximately 1.3% of the effective end-to-end latency, demonstrating that MaLoW introduces only marginal latency overhead in practical streaming inference.
blocks.zh: 紧急故障。 我们进一步分析了图4中报告的MaLOW(Quen3.5-9B)的延迟性,详见表15。 编码新框架并更新隐藏状态 h t h_{t} 生成 LoRA 的 百分位数 A + 1 A_{t+1} 和 B → + 1 B_{t+1} , 将它们合并到构造 Δ t + 1\ Delta\theta_{t+1} 分别占总延迟的7.9%, 2.1%和3.7%。 重要的是,这些操作会计算下一个时间块的适配器,因此可以同时执行QQ t\Delta\theta\t}并且执行当前块的基础-VLM预填和解码. 有了这种线条,只有QQ t\Delta\theta\t}的应用和包头仍然停留在关键的推论路径上,在130.07ms的基础模型推论纬度中增加了1.75ms. 这相当于有效端到端延迟的约1.3%,表明MaLOW在实际流派推论中只引入了边际延迟高空.

blocks.zh: 表15:MaLOW(Quen3.5-9B)延迟的细目。 百分比是相对于152.89毫秒的暂时性总数。

blocks.en: LoRA Hidden State Evolution over the History. Figure 7 visualizes how the internal LoRA state of MaLoW evolves with changes in video content. We compute a V-JEPA-2 ( Assran et al., 2025 ) surprise score on a YouCook2 ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) video by masking the features of the last temporal block and measuring the distance between its predicted representation and the representation of the subsequent block. In parallel, we track the 512-dimensional LoRA hidden state of MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B), defined as Norm ⁡ ( o t ) + α ​ Norm ​ ( s t ) \mathrm{Norm}(o_{t})+\alpha\mathrm{Norm}(s_{t}) . We average the hidden states used to generate layer-specific LoRA adapters and project the resulting representation into two dimensions using t-SNE.
blocks.zh: 洛拉隐藏的国度进化 历史。 图7可视化了内部LORA状态的MALOW如何随着视频内容的变化而演变. 我们计算一个V-JEPA-2(Assran等人,2025年)在YouCook2(周等人,2018年)视频上的惊喜分数,方法是掩盖最后一个时间块的特征,并测量其预测的表示与后续块的表示之间的距离. 同时,我们追踪512维的LORA隐藏状态的MALOW(Quen3.5-9B),定义为Norm QQ(o t) + α Norm (s t)\mathrm{Norm}(o_{t})\alpha\mathrm{Norm}(s_{t}). 我们平均的隐藏状态 用于生成层特异性LORA适配器 并利用 t-SNE 将结果的表示投射为两个维度.

blocks.en: The LoRA state changes more rapidly when the V-JEPA-2 surprise score is high (before 60s and after 130s), while evolving more smoothly during the lower-surprise interval between 60s and 130s. This correspondence suggests that the LoRA state adapts dynamically to changes in the underlying video events.
blocks.zh: LORA状态在V-JEPA-2惊喜得分较高(60年代前,130年代后)时变化更迅速,而在60年代至130年代的低震间距期间发展更顺利. 此函文暗示LORA状态能动态地适应基本视频事件的变化.

blocks.en: Effect of Memory on Real-Time Perception. We investigate whether long-term historical information compressed by MaLoW adversely affects real-time perception on the real-time splits of OVO-Bench and StreamingBench.
blocks.zh: 记忆对实时感知的影响. 我们调查由MALOW压缩的长期历史信息是否对OVO-Bench和Streaming Bench实时分裂的实时感知产生不利影响.

blocks.en: For OVO-Bench, where video prefixes extend up to 28 minutes, we group real-time questions by their preceding video duration into four intervals: 0–5, 5–10, 10–15, and over 15 minutes. As shown in Figure 8 -1, MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) maintains comparable accuracy to the local-window baseline (Qwen3.5-9B, last 2 seconds) across different prefix ranges, suggesting that accumulated memory does not compromise real-time perception.
blocks.zh: OVO-Bench的视频前缀可长达28分钟, 如图8-1所示,MaLOW(Quen3.5-9B)在不同的前缀范围上保持与本地窗口基线(Quen3.5-9B,最后2秒)的可比较准确性,说明累积的内存不影响实时感知.

blocks.en: For StreamingBench, where the original video prefixes are relatively short, we randomly sample 100 samples and construct longer streams by prepending randomly sampled videos, extending the historical context from 5 to 60 minutes. As shown in Figure 8 -2, consistent with the observations on OVO-Bench, MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) maintains stable real-time perception across varying history lengths.
blocks.zh: 对于Streaming Bench, 最初的视频前缀相对较短,我们随机抽取100个样本,通过预先随机抽取的视频来构建更长的溪流,将历史背景从5分钟延长到60分钟. 如图8-2所示,与OVO-Bench观测结果一致,MaLOW(Quen3.5-9B)在不同的历史长度中保持稳定的实时感知.

blocks.en: These observations are consistent with our design choice to regularize the norm of the generated LoRA weights. This regularization constrains the magnitude of memory-induced weight updates, preventing them from dominating the pretrained model weights and disrupting its real-time perception capabilities.
blocks.zh: 这些观测结果符合我们的设计选择,即规范生成的LORA重量的规范. 这种规范化限制了内存引发的重量更新的幅度,使其无法主导预先训练的模型重量,并干扰其实时感知能力.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Effect of Memory on Real-Time Perception. Markers on subplot 1 show bin medians. We evaluate the accuracy of MaLoW on real-time questions across varying history lengths. MaLoW maintains stable real-time perception despite accumulating long-term memory.
blocks.zh: 图8:记忆对实时感知的影响。 子plot 1 上的标记显示 bin 中值 。 我们评估MaLOW对不同历史长度的实时问题的准确性。 尽管积累了长期记忆,但MaLOW保持稳定的实时感知.

blocks.en: Additional Qualitative Results. We provide additional qualitative results in Figure 9 . Samples 1, 2, and 4 further demonstrate that MaLoW (Qwen3.5-9B) can retain long-term historical context through its internalization mechanism. In some cases, however, the retained memory can be vague, as humans do. For example, in Sample 2, which clue appeared 32 minutes before the question timing, MaLoW appears to retain a coarse memory of Coca-Cola and answers “beverage” rather than the specific object.
blocks.zh: 额外定性 结果。 我们在图9中提供了更多的质量结果。 样本1、2和4进一步表明,MALOW(Quen3.5-9B)可以通过其内化机制保留长期历史背景. 然而,在某些情况下,保留下来的记忆会像人类一样模糊不清. 例如,在"样本2"中,线索在提问时间前32分钟出现,MaLOW似乎保留了对可口可乐的粗糙记忆,并回答"beverage"而不是特定对象.

blocks.en: Sample 5 illustrates a failure case in which both MaLoW and the baselines produce incorrect answers, partly due to an inaccurate ground-truth annotation. Sample 3 requires not only remembering the relevant video timestamp, but also an agentic procedure to revisit the corresponding frames and localize the clock displayed in the bottom-right corner. Since MaLoW is not trained with agentic tool-use data, extending it to such agentic settings is left for future work. Finally, Sample 6 requires strong visual perception to recognize that four cards are initially present on the table, followed by temporal reasoning to determine that one additional card is added, yielding five cards in total. We expect such cases to benefit from future base VLMs with stronger fine-grained visual perception.
blocks.zh: 样本5说明了一种失败情况,即MaLOW和基线都得出错误的答案,部分原因是地面真实性说明不准确。 样本3不仅需要记住相关的视频时间戳,还需要一个代理程序来重温相应的帧,将显示在右下角的时钟本地化. 由于MaLOW没有接受过代理工具使用数据的培训,将数据扩展至此类代理设置留待未来工作. 最后,样本6需要强烈的视觉感知,才能承认四张牌最初出现在桌上,然后是时间推理,以确定增加一张牌,结果总共产生五张牌. 我们期望这种案例能够从未来具有更强细纹视觉感知的基数VLM中获益.
